title: Confidential-data protection review
html:
Confidential-data protection review

Evaluate design weaknesses in a data-export service.

Required responses

fields.label: Main key-management improvement

options.value: Restrict and monitor key access separately as appropriate
options.label: Restrict and monitor key access separately as appropriate

fields.correct: Restrict and monitor key access separately as appropriate
fields.explanation: Control over key material is essential to encryption effectiveness.

fields.label: Password-storage improvement

options.value: Use a suitable salted password-hashing scheme
options.label: Use a suitable salted password-hashing scheme

options.value: Use the username as the password
options.label: Use the username as the password

fields.correct: Use a suitable salted password-hashing scheme
fields.explanation: Password verification should not require plaintext storage.

fields.label: Retention improvement

options.value: Include backups in authorized retention and disposal controls
options.label: Include backups in authorized retention and disposal controls

fields.correct: Include backups in authorized retention and disposal controls
fields.explanation: Lifecycle controls need to cover relevant copies and obligations.

fields.label: Effect of broad plaintext export privileges

options.value: Access control still matters even when storage is encrypted
options.label: Access control still matters even when storage is encrypted

options.value: All support users are automatically entitled
options.label: All support users are automatically entitled

fields.correct: Access control still matters even when storage is encrypted
fields.explanation: Authorized decryption pathways can expose data if permissions are excessive.

exhibits.title: Service design
exhibits.html: Confidential records are encrypted at rest. All support users can retrieve both ciphertext and keys. Passwords are stored in plaintext. Backup copies are never included in retention reviews.

exhibits.title: Protection goals
exhibits.html: Only authorized users should recover confidential data, credentials should be protected appropriately, and retention/disposal should cover all relevant copies.
